description: Least-cost Optimal Distribution Grid Expansion (LODGE) v1 is a model or code deposit deposited in DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI) Repository by its authors Miguel Heleno, Alan Valenzuela Meza (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL), Berkeley, CA (United States)). LODGE finds the least-cost portfolio of traditional distribution system upgrades to integrate new loads and behind-the-meter DERs in combination with advanced non-wire alternative (NWA) planning solutions, such as utility-owned storage and distributed PV.
